Hero_Desc_Opal:
A pure and energetic dragon who has just joined the ranking fights.
With her unique sociable personality, she's busy making friends all over Elias.
Typically for her, she's participating in the ranking competition because it gives her a chance to hang out with her dragon- sunbae.
Album_Wish_Opal: To hold a get-together for all races in Elias
Album_Opal1: Opal is a young dragon who has just entered the ranking fights, so everything seems new and exciting to her. They say that even during a fight, she giggles brightly and exclaims that it's so much fun... That sounds a bit scary, actually.
Album_Opal2: Opal listens to me very well. The problem is... she listens to other Apostles very well too and is swayed easily. Daya always seems worried that someone will take advantage of Opal's indecisiveness.
Album_Opal3: I have traveled around Elias for work, and Opal has been everywhere I went. At first, I thought I was hallucinating because I was tired, but she greeted me warmly as if she hadn't seen me in years every time I ran into her. She said she usually goes around like this to meet her friends... I thought Opal might be one of those popular dragons.
Album_Opal4: I watched Opal train hard with Rudd. Opal was enduring Rudd's hard training with a smile on her face the whole time. Rudd was fired up by her enthusiasm, and Opal was only too happy to accept Rudd's praises. I walked away quickly in case I somehow got dragged into it.
Album_Opal5: Once, I refused food from Opal. She started bawling like a baby, devastated that I didn't understand her true feelings. But when I accepted the food, her tears dried up immediately as if nothing happened. It is said that mental fortitude and resilience are inversely proportional...
Album_Opal6: I saw Opal, Kidian, Jade, Rim, and Gabia all playing together. It felt like Opal's one-man show, but the other Apostles seemed to get along well without feeling uncomfortable. Opal laughed and said that she organizes these get-togethers regularly because she doesn't want anyone to feel lonely. What a nice kiddo she is.
Album_Opal7: There are times when I am surprised by Opal's unabashed expression of friendship (?). No matter how much I caution her, she doesn't seem to realize what she's doing wrong. I think I understand why Daya is worried about her.
LoveHero_Opal: The Master and I... are best friends... hehe...
LoveHeroCancel_Opal: But we're still friends, right...? Waaah...!
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Hate1: When I handed her a cold can, she immediately burst into tears. I felt guilty because she kept asking if she had done something wrong even as she cried.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Hate2: She took a whiff of it with an innocent face and froze in place. In a frightened voice, she asked what on earth I had made.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like1: She loved it, using all kinds of descriptions and exclamations to gush about how beautiful the dish was. She said she would serve me something similar if I came to her party later.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like10: After tasting it, Opal cried for quite some time with tears and a runny nose. I worried that it did not suit her palate, but she said it was simply so delicious that she could not stop crying.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like2: She sang my praises for knowing what her favorite food was. Well... but her taste was just too obvious.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like3: She liked the idea that she would age another year because she could become a more grown-up dragon. I doubt it'd make any difference, but if she's happy, that's all it matters.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like4: She jumped with excitement and complimented me for making a nice cake, asking if it was supposed to represent Yggdrasil. It wasn't, but I decided to go with it.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like5: She said the glittering powder was so pretty and sprinkled some in the air. Naturally, it soon got into her eyes and she burst into tears.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like6: Looking at the colorful songpyeon, she said they have a unique texture and shape and asked for the recipe because they would be good party food. I mumbled and glossed over my answer.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like7: She seems captivated by the sweet flavor and cute appearance. She confidently declared that she would make me some chocolates in return.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like8: She said the glittering powder was so pretty and sprinkled some in the air. Naturally, it made her sneeze for a while.
Food_ChefNote_Opal_Like9: Looking at the candies that represented each race, she started to recite the names of her friends from each race. I guess she wants to give them these candies as gifts.

LoveLetter_Opal: Hello, Master! It is Opal. Thanks to you, my life at the Order has been so happy. I learned a great deal today too! I heard that where you lived, people sometimes give gifts to express their gratitude. Mm-hmm, so I prepared one too! I truly hope you like it, Master!
LoveCall_Opal:
Hello, Master! It is adorable Opal!
Master~ Thank you for always taking such good care of me.
I am truly touched that you look after me through rain and wind alike!
Today, while walking on the surface, I found an adorable grub that looked just like you.
It resembled you so closely that it made me think of you, and so I called!

Hmm, nothing particularly special has happened to me lately.
There is one slightly strange thing, though.
Whether I watch falling leaves or drops of rain, I think of you, Master.
Strange, is it not? I do not know what has come over me lately.
Perhaps it means you have become someone very special to me? Ehehe~
Even when I am beside you, I want to stay closer, and no matter how much I see you, I want to see you again!
I will visit the Order again soon. I will see you then, Master!

Affinity_Opal_EP03_004: It is a naive world that sometimes feels a little immature.

Affinity_Opal_EP05_004: It is the thought that matters, not material things.
Affinity_Opal_EP05_005: That must be it, right? Then I will shower her with presents until my feelings reach her~!

Affinity_Opal_EP05_007: You are so greedy, Master! I will work hard to prepare a present for that greedy person too!
Affinity_Opal_EP06_001: What should I do to become a great sunbae like Daya?
Affinity_Opal_EP06_002: When it comes to sparkling, are you not already the best?

Affinity_Opal_EP06_006: It is impossible. Come down to the surface and find your own path too.
Affinity_Opal_EP06_007: What? Daya always told me never to give up! I will keep trying!
Affinity_Opal_EP07_001: Hmm~ What could be wrong... Something is missing...!
Affinity_Opal_EP07_003: What?! But I am always serious! Have you not seen me when I hold a party?
Affinity_Opal_EP07_004: Uhehe~ I am the lacking chief of the lacking tribe!
Affinity_Opal_EP07_005: Wh-what are you... talking about...? I am a little... bewildered... E-ehehe...
